externalId.title: Source id
externalId.description: The code of the application in the source system it was imported from, such as the TOPdesk Applicatie Code (the Middel-ID). Shown for reference; it can change in the source, so it is not used to match records.

externalNumber.title: Source number
externalNumber.description: The application number in the source system, such as TOPdesk's APPID (ICT Applicatienummer). A repeated CMDB import matches on it, through the import key.

externalKey.title: Import key
externalKey.description: The key a repeated import matches this application on: topdesk:<municipality uuid>:<APPID>. Set by the CMDB import; only a Nextcloud admin can change it.

externalCreatedAt.title: Created in source
externalCreatedAt.description: The date the application was registered in the source system.

externalModifiedAt.title: Changed in source
externalModifiedAt.description: The date the application was last changed in the source system.

applicationType.title: Application type
applicationType.description: The kind of application as the source system records it, such as the TOPdesk Applicatiesoort (Webapplicatie, Client/server, Saas). Kept as the source has it.

bbnLevel.title: BBN level
bbnLevel.description: The BBN level (Baseline Informatiebeveiliging Overheid) this application is classified at. BBN2+ is a level the TOPdesk CMDB export uses.

importAcquisition.description: Set the usage to "Acquisition" as the service desk (TOPdesk CMDB import) records it, whatever the current state. Only administrators: the import follows the source, other users follow the transitions above.

importPlanned.description: Set the usage to "Planned" as the service desk (TOPdesk CMDB import) records it, whatever the current state. Only administrators: the import follows the source, other users follow the transitions above.

importInProduction.description: Set the usage to "In production" as the service desk (TOPdesk CMDB import) records it, whatever the current state. Only administrators: the import follows the source, other users follow the transitions above.

importToBePhasedOut.description: Set the usage to "To be phased out" as the service desk (TOPdesk CMDB import) records it, whatever the current state. Only administrators: the import follows the source, other users follow the transitions above.

importPhasedOut.description: Set the usage to "Phased out" as the service desk (TOPdesk CMDB import) records it, whatever the current state. Only administrators: the import follows the source, other users follow the transitions above.
